source_snapshot.procedure: Fully populate and `Run Reboot (100 times)`; the body never defines a cold power-state transition.
source_snapshot.criteria: No BMC/system errors, hang/BSOD or device loss.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; interprets cold reboot as full power off/on but this is not stated in the Master body.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/IMPROVED; requires owner selection of S5/chassis/DC/AC boundary, BMC availability and per-cycle evidence.

old_problem: The title says cold reboot while the procedure only says reboot. The prior review treated the missing power boundary as a parameter, but choosing S5, chassis/DC-off or AC-off changes the tested hardware state and overlaps different formal cases.
disposition_reason: ED-06 requires warm, cold, AC and DC transitions to remain distinct. ED-18 requires the chosen OFF→ON→ready state to be evidenced. The missing boundary is a core hardware-operation semantic, not merely an IP or timing parameter under ED-03; selecting one would invent coverage and may remove the BMC/OOB recovery path.
decision_basis: Directly read Stability row15 all 18 columns, DeepSeek, GPT V2/history3057 and next row16/history3058.
The body is textually identical in its key action to warm reboot (`Run Reboot`) and never establishes host-rail removal, standby state or BMC behavior.
S5 with BMC retained, chassis/DC-off, and complete AC-off exercise different rails/firmware paths and safety/recovery behavior.
Rows12 and14 already cover AC cycling and warm reboot, so an inferred choice could silently duplicate them while losing cold coverage.
Next row16 identity was directly verified; no reboot, power or lab action ran.

test_case.test_name: 100 cold reboots at 40C/+5% rails — blocked pending power-boundary ruling
test_case.purpose: Preserve the independent cold-reboot coverage for a fully populated system while preventing execution until the project defines the exact host/BMC/rail state that constitutes cold OFF and ON.
required_package: Approved cold boundary: S5, chassis/DC-off or AC-off, with BMC state
Exact actuation interface/fixture and true-off proof
test_case.test_command: DO NOT execute `reboot` or substitute an AC cycle. After the owner publishes the cold-state contract, establish full inventory and margin, then for each of 100 cycles actuate exactly that state, prove the approved host/BMC/rail OFF condition and dwell, power ON, prove BMC/POST/OS/service readiness, compare inventory/logs, and stop on any fault. Restore nominal environment after completion.
test_case.expected_result: Not yet authoritatively defined until cold-state semantics are chosen. The future oracle must prove 100 exact cold OFF→ON→ready transitions, complete inventory, no disallowed errors and nominal restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: BLOCKED. An OS warm reboot, an assumed S5, a full AC cycle or final boot cannot pass. PASS becomes possible only after the power boundary is approved and all 100 cycles evidence that exact state.
safety_gate: No power action under ambiguous cold semantics
Preserve BMC/OOB if required by the approved state
Qualified power/environment operator and approved fixture
Abort on control loss, boot/device/electrical/thermal fault; no retry
expected_evidence: Cold-state decision and rail/BMC proof method
test_case.recovery: Recovery depends on the selected power boundary and is therefore not safe to assume. Owners must publish OOB/fixture abort and restoration before execution; on mismatch stop and do not retry.
